scope: Site copy verified against public v1.38.0 on October 18, 2026: your own Start Page image (F49, #945) and the Start Page Color wallpaper (F50, #952), on /features/start-page. Hand-checked on macOS and Windows; the Linux hand check was waived, so the copy makes no platform-specific claim. Later the same day: the line under the Start Page headline, the homepage's wallpaper scene and Start Page card, and the /features wallpaper tile and pop-up.
prohibitedClaims: Four ways to begin. Mahjong when you want a break.
a different image for each space

customImage.qualification: Customize → Wallpaper → Your image, or Settings → General → Start Page image, shows a JPEG or PNG up to 25 MB (MAX_INPUT_BYTES), fitted inside 3840 px. Not in private tabs. Hand-checked on Windows; Linux waived (release report).

washAndFade.qualification: Wash styles Auto, Light, Dark and Spotlight (newtabWallpaperStyle); Light and Dark also set the page's text colors whatever the app theme; Spotlight washes only behind the content and header. Fade (newtabWallpaperWash) runs 0–100, where 0 shows the image as chosen; the footer fog always stays.

imagePrivacy.qualification: The stored copy is re-encoded with every metadata field except orientation removed, owner-only in userData/wallpaper/, device-local and never synced; private tabs never get the image or its controls.

colorWallpaper.qualification: Color draws one of the eight Spaces presets as a Soft, Solid or Gradient fill. newtabColorWallpaper, newtabWallpaperColor, newtabWallpaperFill and newtabFollowSpaceColor are synced through Personal's optional Sync; a device's own image takes priority on that device; private tabs never show a color.

matchSpace.qualification: With Match each space's color on, a window that belongs to a space draws that space's color while the Color wallpaper shows; the page receives only the hex color. There is no separate image per space.

captures.qualification: Captions describe the recorded states in docs/website-captures-v1.38.0.json, taken from the public v1.38.0 arm64 DMG. The painting is a CC0 Met Open Access image used as the sample.

layouts.qualification: The Customize popover offers the four layouts (Ledger, Billboard, Shelf, Tally) and, since v1.38.0, the Sunrise, Color and Your image wallpapers.

mahjongCapture.qualification: The capture shows a fresh profile's standalone Mahjong: the Daily deal, which that day was the Turtle board, in Burst mode.

timeOfDay.qualification: Time-of-day wallpaper (Settings → General or Customize) is unchanged since earlier releases and still available in v1.38.0 beside Color and Your image.

mahjongFooter.qualification: Every Start Page layout's footer links to standalone Mahjong, which opens as an ordinary tab.
